name: visual-review
description: Visual QA skill — renders PDFs and HTML at 300 DPI, runs Quick Pass or Full Review, produces action-first HOLD/FIX IF TIME/NOTE reports covering clipping, overlaps, font fallback, density imbalance, typography, and brand drift. Includes 8 mandatory bottom-edge checks, Paged.js structural patterns, form-aware checks, type-specific checks for slides/books/reports, commercial press-readiness checklist, and conditional stack assessment (surfaces only on CVE, traceable bug, or explicit request).
